summary: Iteration 4 — validated 5 new features: (1) Panchangam extras (samvatsara / vikrama / shaka / ritu / ayana / masa), (2) Kundali Match Aṣṭakūṭa Guṇa Milāna endpoint + UI + PNG/PDF export, (3) Sanskrit almanac block on Panchāngam page, (4) Home AartiTimer with 3 presets + Web-Audio bell + volume slider, (5) FestivalPushOptIn with blocked/enable/toggle states and upcoming-festival list. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass (test_iteration4.py). All API contracts hold. Frontend: Playwright verified Home aarti-timer + festival-push side-by-side, presets reset countdown to 5/7/3 min, Start decreases countdown (03:00→02:58 in 2.5s), Pause + Reset present, volume slider present. Festival push in headless correctly shows festival-notify-blocked (Notification.permission='denied'), 3 upcoming festivals listed. /panchangam: 4/5 quick-nav chips present (see minor issue), section-match + kundali-match render, panch-almanac shows all 6 fields (Samvatsara, Māsa, Ṛtu, Ayana, Vikrama Saṁvat, Śaka Saṁvat) with values Plavanga / Shravana / Shishira / Dakṣiṇāyana / 2083 / 1948 for Aug 2026. KundaliMatch: form filled (Sita 1992-03-15 14:20 Hyderabad, Ram 1990-05-15 08:30 Hyderabad) → match-result rendered with match-total='23.5/36' and match-verdict='Acceptable — Consider carefully' — matches spec exactly. All 8 match-kuta-* bars render. match-export-img → 'kundali-match-Sita-Ram.png' downloaded; match-export-pdf → 'kundali-match-Sita-Ram.pdf' downloaded; match-export-toast visible. /dinacharya: SlokaCard shows voice-sloka block with voice-sloka-play button; click does not throw JS errors (only 401s on unrelated auth/me probes). SW registered with scope '/' and active state. Deity of Day ribbon still visible on home. No console errors related to any new feature.
action_items: (P3 cosmetic) Spec called the first quick-nav chip data-testid 'panch-jump-panch' but the implementation uses 'panch-jump-panchangam' (matches the section id). The chip works — this is a spec-vs-impl naming mismatch only. If E1 wants to match the spec exactly, add both aliases or rename to panch-jump-panch.
critical_code_review_comments: KundaliMatch place-of-birth is a fixed <select> of CITIES rather than a free-text + geocoding input. Tests must use select_option not fill. Consider aligning with KundaliMaker's place-picker for consistency across the two forms.

VoiceSlokaReader relies on SpeechSynthesis 'start' event to flip play→stop button state. In headless Chromium the event may never fire (no voices installed), so the button remains 'play' even though speak() was queued. Not a bug for real browsers but automated tests can only assert no-error; consider optimistically flipping to 'stop' on click() and reverting on 'end'/'error' for better UX.

AartiTimer preset click resets to preset minutes correctly even mid-countdown — good. The Web-Audio bell is muted in headless (no user gesture requirement met via automation click? Actually click IS a user gesture, so bell should synth OK). Cannot assert audio in headless.

FestivalPushOptIn correctly renders the 3 mutually-exclusive states (blocked/enable/toggle) driven by Notification.permission. Note: some browsers do not expose Notification in insecure or iframe contexts — guard access with typeof Notification !== 'undefined' if not already.

Panchangam extras use approximate Gregorian-month-based logic (masa via (month+8)%12, ritu via day-of-year, vikrama shift at April). For Aug 2026 the returned values (Plavanga samvatsara / vikrama 2083 / shaka 1948 / Dakṣiṇāyana / Shishira ritu / Shravana masa) are reasonable but note the Ṛtu value for mid-Aug shows 'Shishira (Winter)' which is wrong — August should be Varsha (Monsoon). See minor issue below.

success_rate.frontend: ~98% (all new features verified; voice-sloka stop-toggle unverifiable in headless, spec-vs-impl chip-id mismatch is cosmetic)

test_credentials: N/A — all iteration-4 features are guest-accessible.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Kundali match is stateless (no DB writes).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py (10 pytest). All previous iterations' tests (test_astrology_features.py, test_divine_journey.py, test_geo_pwa.py) remain valid. When testing KundaliMatch form via Playwright, note that place-of-birth is a <select> (not text input) — use page.select_option(..., index=0). Headless SpeechSynthesis does not fire 'start'/'end' events, so voice-sloka-stop is not reachable via toggling — assert no JS errors instead. Notification.permission is always 'denied' in headless Chromium, so festival-notify-blocked is the only observable state. Match total for spec sample (Sita 1992-03-15 14:20 / Ram 1990-05-15 08:30 both Hyderabad) is exactly 23.5/36 verdict='Acceptable — Consider carefully'.
rca of the issue: Minor Ṛtu computation bug: panchangam_extras() ritu_idx loop in /app/backend/astrology.py iterates the ritu_map dict without sorting by (month,day), and the January entry (1,20,5) is checked last — for August dates the comparison (d.month,d.day) >= (m,day) is True for entries (3,22,0),(5,22,1),(7,22,2) then False for (9,23,3),(11,22,4) but ALSO True for (1,20,5) since (8,X) >= (1,20) is True — so ritu_idx ends up 5 (Shishira/Winter) instead of 2 (Varsha). RCA: The map should be traversed as an ordered list and matched by CURRENT solar-year progression rather than a raw tuple compare that wraps January. Mitigation: use a linear year-based DOY range check or exclude the (1,20,5) entry unless d is actually in Jan/Feb before Mar 22. Impact: LOW — extras field only, not required by test assertion (test only checks value is one of 6 allowed strings). Suggest E1 fix ritu logic if calendar accuracy matters.
